content.text: The verifier's narrative again confirms every substantive element; the sole failing signal is the heuristic frequency check, which cannot pass in a document containing no audit right. There is no defect to repair — re-submitting the compliant finding unchanged in substance, with no redline and no comment.

input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: Compliant; no redline and no comment. The Agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right over Clear Capital. Section 3(b) (p0014) — the location the planner flagged — is a one-way invoicing mechanic under which the Contractor must supply supporting detail, dates, hours and expense receipts with its invoices; it gives the Contractor no right to examine our records, usage, systems or premises. The only access-related provision, § 1 (p0007), runs in our favour: Contractor personnel must comply with our facility rules and our policies concerning access to and security of any Company computer system. Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif", "examine", "books", "review" and "records" return no examination right binding us ("records" appears only in the IP-ownership and confidentiality definitions; "premises" only in the recital boilerplate). The complete absence of any audit right is strictly better for us than the preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor's cost, no system access), so there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain and nothing to edit; proposing a redline would insert a counterparty audit right that does not presently exist, which is worse for us than silence. The failed deterministic check "audit frequency limited" is heuristic noise: no frequency cap can be located because there is no audit right to cap, not because audits are unlimited or unannounced. Compliant rather than "missing" is correct because AUDIT is a protective cap on a counterparty right, so its absence creates no gap requiring new language. Residual watch item: if a Statement of Work later introduces a usage-verification or records-examination right, the preferred limits should be applied at that point.
